symbols.H_0: entropy of the optimal action under the prior P_0
symbols.I_0: mutual information between optimal action A^* and expert data D_N^* under P_0

conditions: expectation taken over all randomness including the expert data D_N^*

source.label: thm:regret_reduction
source.quote: Let an agent follow a Thompson Sampling algorithm with a prior inferred from the expert-updated posterior $P_1(\theta) = P(\theta \mid D_N^*)$. Their expected Bayesian regret taken over all sources of randomness including the expert data $D_N^*$, is \mathbb{E}[Reg_{\text{TS}_1}(T)] \le C \sqrt{T \left( \mathbb{H}_0(A^*) - \mathbb{I}_0(A^*; D_N^*) \right)} where $C$ is a problem-dependent constant...

results.notes: Paper's C renamed C_prob (not corruption). Derived from Russo & Van Roy (2016) via Jensen. Horizon recorded as anytime since TS does not use T; not explicitly stated.
